The Studio

Spaces that feel as extraordinary as they look

Divyn Atelier is a luxury residential interior design studio with over 25 years of experience creating refined, deeply personal spaces. We specialise in classical, modern, and bespoke interiors — environments that are elegant, timeless, and unmistakably yours.

From grand bungalows to palatial classical residences, every project begins with listening — to who you are, how you live, and what endures. We also design and handcraft bespoke furniture, so every element of your home is intentional.

A complete vision,
fully realised

From the first sketch to the final flourish, we design, craft, and deliver residences of enduring distinction — across Delhi NCR and beyond.

How We Work

From first meeting
to final key

01

Discovery

A private conversation about how you live, what you love, and the home you have always imagined for yourself.

02

Concept Design

Mood boards, spatial planning, material palettes, and 3D visualisations that bring your home to life before a single wall is touched.

03

Craftsmanship

Every element — furniture, finishes, lighting, art — procured or handcrafted to our exacting standards across India and Europe.

04

Delivery

A complete handover. Your home, fully realised — installed, styled, and ready the moment you walk in.
